author: BernieSanders
text:
Candidate Trump: "We’re going to get gasoline below $2 a gallon."

Candidate Trump: "I’m not going to start a war. I’m going to stop wars.”

President Trump this week: $4.44 a gallon gas "is a very inexpensive price" to pay for the Iran War he started.

Enough. End the war NOW!
